comments.text:
This script has really high memory creep. Through extensive testing it appears that using only the "(Select)" mode is the most efficient, but expect 7gb-10gb total memory usage within 2 hours of running the script.

The developers of peak evolution are also looking at creating an anti-cheat to tackle this specific script / variations of this script. They're trying to remove the "Teleport to enemy, kill enemy, teleport to enemy" ability, or at least auto-kick when you run it. They might never make the fix, but just be aware they have said they're working on it.

Other than the awful memory management and the threat from devs, this script works like a dream! Highly recommend if your PC can handle it.
@Meerly bro is a master of Bullshido....
